name: ffl-extension
description: FFL's browser extension (ffl-soc.6.3.2, #130): pairs with the FFL open in a tab (or by a code) and sends that browser's ESPN login (espn_s2, SWID) to it.

scripts.build: node build.mjs --target chrome && node build.mjs --target safari
scripts.package: pnpm build && cd dist/chrome && rm -f ../ffl-chrome-$npm_package_version.zip && zip -qrX ../ffl-chrome-$npm_package_version.zip . && echo dist/ffl-chrome-$npm_package_version.zip
